title: rosidl_adapter.parser.InvalidFieldDefinition and "is an invalid field name" in ROS 2 custom messages: missing names, type spelling, srv separators and keyword fields, measured
excerpt: What each rosidl_adapter error means when a custom .msg or .srv fails to build: a type with no field name, geometry_msgs/msg/Twist, camelCase fields, float instead of float64, missing --- separators, a field named class and a missing DEPENDENCIES line. Built on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
